assumptions: All numeric laboratory endpoints, time constants, complication probabilities, and outcome probabilities are illustrative synthetic parameters, not fitted clinical estimates.
Outcome probabilities apply once per completed 24-hour model step, conditional on etiology and current severity; they are not annual risks or transplant eligibility criteria.
Severity is a synthetic acute functional impairment index from 0 to 1, separate from hepatocyte injury activity and chronic baseline abnormalities.

Clinical pattern references: https://www.aasld.org/liver-fellow-network/core-series/back-basics/defining-and-managing-acute-liver-failure and https://www.aasld.org/liver-fellow-network/core-series/clinical-pearls/management-acute-chronic-liver-failure

inr.display: INR in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay

ast.display: Aspartate aminotransferase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma

alt.display: Alanine aminotransferase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma

assumptions: Candidacy, graft availability, rejection, timing, laboratory, and outcome parameters remain synthetic assumptions. Only the aggregate ICU-to-transplant target is fitted to the user-defined scenario, not observed MedStar outcomes.
Candidacy is drawn once per evaluation; graft availability is drawn once per completed waiting day after competing clinical outcomes. Alcohol-use status alone never determines candidacy.

There is no forced recovery/death horizon or automatic waitlist expiry. Daily competing outcomes continue; an observation cutoff must be reported as censoring, never converted into a clinical outcome. This is an inpatient waiting model, not a longitudinal outpatient waitlist.

Continuous organ support is represented by device and medication intervals, with care plans and instantaneous procedure markers; surgery is a timed procedure. Devices retain timestamp precision where Synthea care-plan CSVs retain only dates. No ICU-specific encounter class or hospital transfers are introduced.

One optional mild rejection episode at the first outpatient visit resolves under a simplified treatment/monitoring course. Drug product strengths and levels are synthetic record content, not a prescribing protocol.

calibration.target_definition: Completed liver transplantation during the index liver ICU/inpatient course divided by all index liver ICU entrants, including recipients who subsequently die.
calibration.target_source: User-defined scenario: 25% of regional liver cases referred to MGUH; 25% of liver ICU entrants receive a transplant.
assumptions: The balanced etiology mix, severe presentation range, stable initial trajectory, and age 50 are calibration fixtures, not measured MGUH case mix. Refit when these change.
The runner samples regional ICU-eligible cases, applies referral once per case, and follows referred cases through the real Synthea engine. Routine regional cases may not require ICU.
The 25% transplant target is pooled across etiologies, not imposed separately on each cause. Transplantation is counted from a completed procedure, not evaluation, listing, or hospital survival.
Annual regional incidence and ICU entry fraction remain unspecified. Annual weights are emitted only when both inputs are supplied; no all-indication liver transplant volume is inferred.

The existing population cirrhosis module is mixed-cause. Its episodes use the cirrhosis profile unless a caller explicitly records liver_cirrhosis_etiology=alcohol. No alcohol-use disorder is inferred.

The generic cirrhosis profile initially copies the illustrative chronic profile coefficients. Entry severity is a synthetic uniform draw; admission mix, mortality, length of stay, and recurrence are not clinically calibrated.
Severe functional impairment or an organ-support indication prompts ICU care. Ward patients have daily reassessment and may recover, deteriorate, die, or require ICU/transplant evaluation.

The existing hospital cohort is not subjected to another 25% referral draw. Regional referral selection belongs upstream. The earlier 25% ICU transplant fit applies to its reference case mix and does not establish this new cohort rate.

Owned chronic medications are held on ICU escalation and reconciled at follow-up seven days after medical recovery. Transplant recipients leave the native-liver cirrhosis management loop; existing recipient follow-up continues in the shared care course.
An explicit one-hour ED workup precedes the initial shared assessment, separating ED and inpatient encounter times without inserting gaps into the daily liver-model clock.

cirrhosis_calibration.target_definition: Completed liver transplantation during the index liver ICU/inpatient course divided by all index liver ICU entrants, including recipients who subsequently die.
cirrhosis_calibration.target_source: User accepted approximately 21% after the completed training fit produced 20.74% (2026-10-25); original ICU target was 25%. Regional referral assumption remains 25%.
assumptions: Regional cases are patients with an index cirrhosis decompensation, not a regional general-population sample. Referral is applied once upstream of the hospital parent.

The harness conditions on diagnosis and first decompensation, then uses the production ED/ward/ICU logic and severity draw without forcing outcomes. Native-liver follow-up terminates observation before recurrence.

Generic mixed-cause cirrhosis is the current population entry profile. Age 50, renal baseline 0.9, and fixed demographic/coverage fixtures are not measured MGUH case mix; unrelated disease modules are absent.
The fitted cirrhosis evaluation multiplier applies only to native-liver ICU episodes entered through the cirrhosis bridge. The direct-ICU reference multiplier is retained.

The accepted ICU-transplant target denominator includes only index ICU entrants, not referred patients managed entirely on the ward. Completed operations count even if the recipient dies; unresolved native-liver outcomes cannot validate a fit.
Annual incidence, mortality, length of stay, recurrence, alcohol/viral/NASH proportions, and background-disease effects remain uncalibrated.

accepted_training_result.selection: Explicit user acceptance before independent validation; no further fitting.
